senses.gloss: (b. h.; √בך to break through, split, v. Ges. H. Dict. s. v.; v. בכר) to weep.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 7b:10">Ḥull. 7ᵇ</cite>; a. fr. Ohol. XVIII, 4 <he>שדה בּוֹכִין</he> weepers’ field, a place where the funeral cortege disperses; v.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 5b:14">M. Kat. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>שדה שמפטירין בה מתים</he> (Ms. M. <he>שמפסידין</he>) where the funeral addresses are held.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:26">Lam. R. to I, 2</cite> (ref. to <he>בכה תבכה</he>) <he>בוכה ומְבַכָּה מה״ש עמה</he> she cries and makes the angels cry with her.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:24">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> <he>היו מְבַכִּין אותו</he> they made it (the Egyptian child) cry.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 2:8">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. II, 8</cite> <he>מְבַכּוֹת מיתיהן</he> lament their dead.
